questions.answer: X is in tension with extension 81.5 - 80.0 = 1.5 mm, so its end forces point away from its centre. Y is in compression with compression 60.0 - 58.8 = 1.2 mm, so its end forces point toward its centre. In each case the opposite end forces can be equal, giving zero resultant force and no acceleration, while their directions still produce opposite deformations.
